verdicts.scope: these six strings only; transliteration then follows (qiṭʿata kaʿk, thalāthatu danānīr, bi-ʿasharati junayhāt, khamsatu arghifa, khudh qiṭʿata kaʿk)
verdicts.reason: Real: l.56 'qiṭʿa kaʿk', l.80 'Thalātha danānīr', l.1003 'bi-ʿashara junayhāt', l.1052 'Khamsa arghifa', l.1811 'qiṭʿa kaʿk' teach a pronunciation with the construct -t dropped, which is wrong in MSA (no pause between muḍāf and muḍāf ilayh). But an engine rule cannot tell construct from noun + adjective (قِطْعَة كَبِيرَة must stay qiṭʿa kabīra), and the engine never guesses a vowel, so the fix belongs in the Arabic. The cases chosen follow the syntax of each line.
